content.value_statement: Creating Lark API skills requires API discovery, scopes, and safe command patterns. This skill provides a reusable authoring template for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains lark-cli command forms for registered APIs, shortcuts, raw OpenAPI calls, and schema lookup.
Shows how to research available services, parameters, and scopes before writing a new skill.
Provides a SKILL.md template with metadata, commands, permissions, and workflow notes.
Recommends confirming write operations and using dry-run previews when available.
Guides authors to reference shared Lark setup and OpenAPI explorer skills.
limitations: It does not execute commands or validate a generated skill by itself.
It depends on lark-cli, authenticated Lark access, and correct tenant permissions.
Raw OpenAPI calls still require careful review of paths, payloads, and scopes.
Generated skills may need manual testing before marketplace publication.

use_cases.title: Create Internal Automation Skills
use_cases.description: Create reusable skills for repeated Lark workspace actions without rewriting command steps.

use_cases.title: Standardize Developer Guidance
use_cases.description: Standardize lark-cli patterns, permissions, and safety notes for team-authored skills.

use_cases.title: Document Office Workflows
use_cases.description: Document approved Lark API workflows so AI assistants can follow consistent procedures.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use lark-skill-maker to draft a skill for listing Lark meeting rooms. Include metadata, commands, and required scopes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner skill creation for one read-only task.

prompt_templates.title: Wrap a Registered API
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lark-cli skill for a registered API that fetches calendar events. Show schema lookup and command usage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate authoring with an existing CLI resource.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Lark skill that searches records, stores the returned ID, and uses it in a follow-up update step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow design with data passed between steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Skill for Publication
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this proposed Lark skill for trigger quality, permission clarity, rollback notes, and write-operation safeguards.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before sharing a generated skill.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for searching Lark meeting rooms.
output_examples.output: A concise skill outline with trigger description, lark-cli research steps, room search plan, and scope notes.

output_examples.input: Turn a multi-step approval workflow into a skill.
output_examples.output: A workflow-focused draft that separates discovery, ID capture, update actions, failure handling, and user confirmation points.
A checklist-style review covering description triggers, permissions, command safety, dry-run usage, and missing validation steps.

best_practices: Confirm user intent before documenting write or delete operations.
List required scopes near each operation so reviewers can assess permissions.
Test generated commands in a limited workspace before sharing the skill.
anti_patterns: Do not use raw OpenAPI calls when a registered lark-cli command already fits.
Do not omit scopes, authentication requirements, or tenant assumptions.
Do not publish generated skills without manual review and command testing.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It helps draft SKILL.md files that teach AI assistants how to use lark-cli for Lark API workflows.

faq.question: Does it run Lark API commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides authoring guidance and command patterns. Actual execution depends on the AI tool and user approval.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What prerequisites are needed?
faq.answer: Users need lark-cli installed, Lark authentication, and permissions for the target APIs.

faq.question: How should write operations be handled?
faq.answer: Generated skills should require clear user confirmation and use dry-run previews when the command supports them.

faq.question: Is it ready for marketplace publication?
faq.answer: This review found no malicious behavior in SKILL.md. Marketplace policy may still require final code-derived approval.
